steps.title: Analyzer: rules.py - deterministic candidate insights (kind/severity/confidence/evidence/template prose/facts) from the tool payloads
steps.change: `rules.py` is pure: `evaluate(run: Run, overview: dict, history: dict, statuses: dict[str, dict], events: list[dict], now: datetime) -> list[Candidate]` where `overview`/`history` are `json.loads(ToolResult.content)` of the two app tools (`tools.fit` only drops whole list items, so the content stays valid JSON; an error result decodes to `{"error": …}` and the rules treat it as absent), and `statuses` is `run.status_cache` (subject → full workload payload incl. `pods` with `phase`, `restarts`, `waitingReason`, `lastTerminated`, and `conditions`, `desired/updated/ready`) and `events` is `run.events_cache` (`reason`, `object` `<Kind>/<name>`, `message`, `count`, `first`, `last`). `models.py` gains `Candidate` (dataclass: `subject`, `kind`, `severity`, `confidence`, `evidence: list[EvidenceRef]`, `title`, `summary`, `facts: list[str]`) — `facts` are the short lines the narration receives. Rules, evaluated per workload subject, each returning (kind, severity, confidence, refs, facts) or nothing; events are attributed to a workload with the existing `workload_matchers(kind, name)` (k8s_tools) so pod/ReplicaSet events map to their owner: - `oom`: any pod `lastTerminated.reason == "OOMKilled"` or event reason `OOMKilling`/`OOMKilled` → critical, high; facts: pod name, exit code 137, restarts. - `image_pull`: pod `waitingReason ∈ {ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull, InvalidImageName}` or event `Failed`/`BackOff` whose message contains `pull` / `image` → critical, high; facts: the image (from `images`), the event message head. - `crashloop`: `waitingReason == CrashLoopBackOff` or event `BackOff` with `restarting failed container`, and not `oom` → critical, high; facts: restarts, last exit code, `lastTerminated.reason`. - `probe_failure`: event `Unhealthy` (message `Liveness`/`Readiness`/`Startup probe failed`) → warning (critical if `ready == 0`), medium (high with ≥ 2 refs); facts: which probe, count. - `scheduling`: pod `phase == Pending` with event `FailedScheduling`, or `FailedScheduling` alone → critical if `ready < desired` else warning; high; facts: message head (`Insufficient cpu`, taints…). - `resource_pressure`: event `Evicted` / message `The node was low on resource` → warning, high. (An eviction is the pod's `status.reason`, which `_pod_summary` does not carry — never a container `lastTerminated.reason`; the event is the signal.) - `rollout_stuck`: condition `Progressing` `status == False` (`reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded`), or `updated < desired` and `ready < desired` with no symptom rule → warning, medium. - `config_change_regression`: no symptom rule fired, overview `health.status` not healthy (`ready < total`), and the newest history entry `isIncident` (or `changeClass == config`) is newer than `CHANGE_CORRELATION_WINDOW_S = 1800` → warning, medium; refs `gen:<generation>` + workload. - `other`: no rule fired but this workload has `ready < desired` or ≥ 1 warning event → warning, low; refs workload (+ event refs). Correlation: whenever a symptom rule fired and an incident/config change is newer than the window, append `gen:<generation>` to the evidence and a fact line `"N min after change gen G: <field> <old>→<new>"` (first change of the entry, values cut to `CHANGE_VALUE_MAX`). One candidate per subject by the precedence in the edge-case table; evidence = union of matched rules' refs, first `MAX_EVIDENCE_PER_INSIGHT`, every ref present in `run.refs` (validate() will check again). Templates (constants.py, `RULE_TITLE_TEMPLATES[kind]`, `RULE_SUMMARY_TEMPLATES[kind]`) formatted from the facts: e.g. crashloop title `{name} is crash-looping`, summary `Pod {pod}: CrashLoopBackOff, {restarts} restarts, last exit code {code}.{change}` — cut to `MAX_INSIGHT_TITLE_LENGTH`/`MAX_INSIGHT_SUMMARY_LENGTH`. Match strings (`OOMKilled`, `CrashLoopBackOff`, `ImagePullBackOff`, `ErrImagePull`, `FailedScheduling`, `Unhealthy`, `Evicted`, `ProgressDeadlineExceeded`, `BackOff`, probe words) are constants. `FAST_STATUS_MAX = 3`; `select_status_subjects(run, events) -> list[str]` picks the workloads to fetch (those with warning events first, then overview order) — S5 calls it before the status gathers.

steps.title: Analyzer: gather_rules (gather -> rules) + narrate (one schema-constrained call, never raises) beside run_analysis (deep, unchanged); NARRATE prompt/schema
steps.change: analyzer.py keeps `run_analysis` unchanged under its current name (deep mode; no rename churn in main.py and the existing tests). Two new functions, no callback: `async def gather_rules(run, k8s, now) -> list[Emitted]` = steps (1)–(2) below, and `async def narrate(ollama_client, model, candidates, sleep=asyncio.sleep) -> list[Narrated] | None` = step (4); the worker (S6) orders them gather_rules → first write → `runtime.check` → narrate → second write, so a slow or unreachable runtime (2 × `OLLAMA_META_TIMEOUT_S` for tags + show) never delays the cards. (1) gather with `tools.invoke` (same caps, refs, `status_cache`, `events_cache`, truncation and error mapping as the loop): overview, `get_change_history(limit 5)`, `get_recent_events(sinceMinutes 60)`, then `get_workload_status` for `rules.select_status_subjects(run, run.events_cache)`; (2) `candidates = rules.evaluate(...)`; `emitted = [Emitted(kind, subject, title, summary, confidence, severity, evidence) …]` returned to the worker; (3) (worker, S6) first write + card events; (4) `narrate` (called by the worker only when the runtime is `ready` and there are candidates): one `_chat` (existing busy retry) with `[system NARRATE_SYSTEM, user narrate_message(candidates)]`, `tools=[]`, `fmt=narrate_schema(n)`, `num_predict = NARRATE_NUM_PREDICT_BASE + NARRATE_NUM_PREDICT_PER_INSIGHT * n` (16 + 120·n: at the caps one item is ≈ 20 title + ≈ 60 summary + ≈ 12 JSON-syntax tokens, so 90 would cut the JSON of a full-length item and lose the whole narration), timeout `ANALYZER_NARRATE_TIMEOUT_SEC` (no `ANALYZER_WALL_SEC` on the fast path: the gather is bounded by `TOOL_TIMEOUT_S` per call); decode `NarrateOutput` (models.py: `insights: list[Narrated(title ≤ 80, summary ≤ 240)]`, `extra=forbid`); return None unless `len == n`; the worker applies per item only when both strings are non-empty after strip; on `(OllamaError, ValueError)` — the client's whole error vocabulary (the `OllamaError` base covers 500 model-load/memory refusals and 400s that `_FAILURE_TYPES` omits) plus decode errors (`ValidationError` and `JSONDecodeError` are `ValueError`s) → return None, the caller keeps templates and logs the exception class. The worker builds `timings` (`gather`, `rules`, `narrate`, `total` seconds) and `steps = 1 if narrated else 0`, `tool_calls = run.tool_calls`, `truncated = run.truncated`; `Outcome` is unchanged. prompts: `NARRATE_SYSTEM` (byte-stable, first): "You write the title and summary of Kubernetes findings for an operator. Use only the given facts. Title ≤ 80 characters, summary ≤ 240 characters, plain sentences, no markdown, no speculation, keep names exactly as given."; `narrate_message(candidates)` = compact JSON list of `{i, kind, workload, severity, facts[]}`; `narrate_schema(n)` = `{"type":"object","required":["insights"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"insights":{"type":"array","minItems":n,"maxItems":n,"items":{"type":"object","required":["title","summary"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"title":{"type":"string","maxLength":80},"summary":{"type":"string","maxLength":240}}}}}}`. Constants: `NARRATE_TITLE_MAX = 80`, `NARRATE_SUMMARY_MAX = 240`, `NARRATE_NUM_PREDICT_BASE = 16`, `NARRATE_NUM_PREDICT_PER_INSIGHT = 120`, `FAST_HISTORY_LIMIT = 5`, `FAST_EVENTS_SINCE_MIN = 60`, `LOG_RUN_TIMINGS = "run {} timings: gather={:.1f}s rules={:.3f}s narrate={:.1f}s total={:.1f}s narrated={} reason={}"` (first field = the runId / stream id, never namespace or names; reason = exception class name or ""; S6 logs it). The estimate/fit helpers are not used on the fast path (prompt ≤ ~500 tokens by construction; `truncate:false` still makes Ollama fail loudly).
